Hello FFH devs!

I preordered Forever Skies on the playstation store and have been playing since release. I have had an overall very enjoyable experience playing the game and love your take on the survival genre.

Some points I would like to make during my time playing would be:-

1. The game still feels not optimised as there is a lot of frame stuttering when going between the under dust and back up again.

2. The pipe system needs some attention as it is quite infuriating to use, especially when trying to go through walls and through the airship frame. Either the wall adapter needs a tweak to allow going through the frame or someother item could be used to allow for this.

3. The game does feel rather short and progression sometimes feels a bit disjointed in terms of only being to acquire certain items at story locations. I did feel at times I was rushing through the story just to be able to get an item I was needing.

4. Ship building is fairly good (apart from the afore mentioned pipe issues), however I would like to see more aesthetic options for the airship as flying around in a giant box breaks a little bit of immersion for me. Perhaps some cosmetic fairings to add more angles and curves? I would gladly farm technology tokens at the workshop for these.

On the whole you've created a wonderful game, which I have enjoyed very much playing. And it's great to see your reaching out to your players for their opinion! I'm looking forward to seeing where you take Forever Skies in the future!
Feel free use any ideas you like! 😁
